info.name: PRED Trading Platform Authentication User API

items.docs:
Prepare a Safe wallet approval transaction. Send `safe_wallet_address` = your `proxy_wallet_addr` from login; sign the returned `transactionHash` with raw secp256k1 (no EIP-191); then call execute with signature and data.

See **Trading Enablement** section for full flow and mandatory re-login after execute.
Execute with the raw secp256k1 signature of `transactionHash` from prepare. See **Trading Enablement** section for mandatory re-login after this call (required for order placement).
